hooks.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(printf '%s\n' "$input" | sed -n 's/.*"cwd" *: *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | sed 's/\\\\/\\/g'); [ -n "$cwd" ] && root=$(git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ -f "$root/.claude/hooks/gofmt.sh" ] || exit 0; printf '%s' "$input" | bash "$root/.claude/hooks/gofmt.sh"
